text:
lina: quick heads-up — SAST/DAST triage needed. serializer in redwood/event-stream may emit small key identifiers in telemetry; proposing a scoped RBAC change + audit checks before we roll to prod.
mike: can you show the exact finding? link or snippet?
lina: SAST id 9012 — pattern: serializer concatenates env tag into payload.header. risk: attacker could craft env that leaks key_id-like strings. no plaintext key material, but metadata leakage is sensitive. scans.internal/9012
olivia: tagging for review. we need to know whether any PII flows and if DAST can reproduce exfil pattern.
security-bot: Alert: SAST high 'metadata-exfil' at event-stream/serialize.py:210. See https://scans.internal/9012. KMS audit policy: ensure key access logs attached to PR.
qa: DAST smoke ran in staging and triggered a match for regex KEY_ID_[A-Z0-9]{8} in emitted events during the probe. reproduced with synthetic payload.
mike: proposed mitigation?
lina: 1) short-term: create a read-only RBAC role limited to attribute resource.labels.env=canary and policy filter to drop header.env field for that consumer. deploy to canary only.
2) mid-term: change serializer to whitelist fields and canonicalize env input; add unit + e2e tests that assert header.env redacted.
3) long-term: add a pre-merge SAST block for serializers and a DAST regression test that fails CI if emitted events match secret-like regexes.
olivia: suppression policy note: we only accept temporary SAST suppression if the fix is in same PR and unit/e2e tests demonstrate mitigation. security signoff required.
devex: I'll add a PR template checklist: RBAC diff, KMS audit snippet, DAST reproduction logs, unit/e2e evidence, suppression form if used.
oncall: rollback playbook if a leak is detected from canary: 1) revoke consumer role, 2) scale the consumer to zero, 3) open INC-7700, 4) export last 1k events to secure blob. owners: @mike (rollback exec) & @lina (postmortem).
mike: how should canary audit be run? paste quick commands.
olivia: here's a simple GCP audit query — run after canary traffic:

gcloud logging read "jsonPayload.stream=\"event-stream\" AND resource.labels.env=\"canary\"" --limit 500 --project=redwood-canary | jq -r '.jsonPayload|@json' | grep -E "(KEY_ID_[A-Z0-9]{6,}|secret|password|private_key)"

# KMS crypto access (if any)
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName: \"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"consumer-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 50 --project=redwood-canary

lina: will add an automated audit attachment step that collects the grep output and uploads to the PR once canary finishes.
qa: DAST probe will be extended to include poisoned env values to ensure serializer redaction is effective. will attach logs to PR.
olivia: triage thresholds: if DAST reproduces >3 key-id matches in 10 minutes or SAST shows an unmitigated high finding, abort rollout and open umbrella triage ticket TRI-7788.
devex: ETA to update pipeline templates and comment suppression form: today EOD. will also add automation to attach the audit grep to PRs touching serializers.
mike: canary deploy scheduled in 45m; i'll post audit output to this thread. if we see any match we rollback immediately.
oncall: added INC-7700 to rotation and updated dashboards: event-stream-errors, audit-alerts. :lock:
lina: thanks — follow-ups: mike runs canary + posts logs, devex updates PR template, olivia does suppression review if needed, qa runs extended DAST probe.
